name: unknown-member
note: A member the schema does not define is an error unless its name starts with x-.

name: wrong-seat-acts
note: A has priority after playing the land (117.3c); B cannot act.

name: tier-2-fact-in-tier-1-record
note: Status is a tier-2 fact; the record declares tier 1.

name: color-spelling
note: Colors are spelled white, blue, black, red, green.

name: library-move-without-at
note: A move into a library says where the card goes, or a shuffle of the same transition lists it.

name: ambiguous-graveyard-order
note: Two cards enter a graveyard at once; their order must be stated (404.3).

name: shuffle-order-misses-a-card
note: Plains is still in the library but neither in the shuffle order nor placed after it.

name: shuffle-order-with-another-seats-card
note: Swamp belongs to B.

name: attempt-with-empty-delta
note: An illegal attempt changes nothing itself; it carries a delta only for the implied answers that followed it, never an empty one.

name: answer-does-not-match-question
note: The pending question is priority; declare_attackers answers only the attack declaration.

name: pass-is-not-an-answer
note: Passing priority is implied by the next entry (section 5.6); there is no pass answer.

name: written-null-answer
note: No blockers is the null answer of the declaration; it is implied, never written (section 5.6).

name: finished-but-pending
note: A finished game has no pending question.

name: unknown-card
note: plains9 is not in the card table.

name: token-numbered-out-of-order
note: Tokens are numbered in creation order: the second token is T2.

name: oracle-name-differs
note: The name must be the pinned Oracle name of the card's oracle id.

name: unknown-counter-kind-warns
note: A counter kind the pinned card text and rules do not name is a warning, not an error.

name: keyword-misspelled
note: Keyword abilities are spelled as section 702 names them.

name: card-ceases-to-exist
note: Only tokens and copies cease to exist; a card always has a zone.

name: two-zones-at-start
note: A card is in exactly one zone.

name: unknown-action-kind
note: The error names the kind and lists the known ones.

name: pending-about-missing
note: order_triggers names the abilities awaiting placement in about.abilities.

name: cast-card-left-where-it-was
note: A cast spell leaves the hand (601.2a); a delta that leaves it there does not agree with the decision.

name: blocking-a-creature-that-is-not-attacking
note: T1 is not attacking.

name: card-to-another-seats-hand
note: A card goes only to its owner's hand, library or graveyard (400.3).

name: keyword-not-lowercase
note: Keywords are lowercase (section 8.5).

name: ability-paragraph-the-card-does-not-have
note: A Mountain's only line is reminder text, so it has no numbered paragraph; its mana ability is {rule: 305.6}.

name: seat-letter-as-card-id
note: A single capital letter is a seat, never a card id.

name: stack-ability-with-a-characteristic
note: An ability on the stack has no characteristics (405.4).

name: blocked-without-attacking
note: Only an attacking creature becomes blocked (509.1h).

name: emblem-outside-the-command-zone

emblem.text: You have no maximum hand size.

note: An emblem is put into the command zone (114.2).

name: adding-on-an-ability-that-adds-no-mana
note: Intrepid Tenderfoot's ability puts a counter and uses the stack; adding belongs to a mana ability only (605.1a).

name: mana-ability-without-adding
note: A Forest's intrinsic mana ability adds mana and uses no stack (305.6, 605.3); the activation records what it added.

name: status-written-on-a-dying-creature
note: A creature put into a graveyard is a new object (400.7): its damage, status, counters and combat facts are never written in the delta that moves it (spec 4.1).

name: companion-answer-names-a-main-deck-card
note: A companion is revealed from outside the game: a sideboard card of that seat with companion (103.2b, 702.139a).

name: companion-action-names-another-card
note: The companion special action puts the revealed companion into its owner's hand (116.2g, 702.139a).
